source.kind: user-attached compiled MP4 (not committed to the repository)
source.method: contact sheets at 1 frame / 2 s plus targeted frames, reviewed by eye; audio checked only with silence detection, not listened to

findings.observed: Six captions break onto a second line holding only a word fragment, e.g. a lone two-letter word, although each fits on one line.
findings.rootCause: Renderer limit for 9:16 is 19 counted characters and counts Unicode code points. Thai vowel and tone marks take no width, so captions of 16-19 visible characters measure 20-23.
findings.evidenceFromJson: 6 of 18 subtitleCues exceed 19 code points; all six measure 16-19 without combining marks. The preflight's simulated wrap reproduces all six observed breaks.

findings.observed: Chapter card text starts at the horizontal centre and runs off the right edge; the third title is clipped.
findings.rootCause: Likely the Thai canvas textAlign='center' glyph offset already documented near index.html line 3555 and worked around for captions. The chapter card still draws with textAlign='center' (about line 3609). Inferred from code reading, not reproduced in a browser.
findings.needs: pixel test like tests/thai-subtitle-safe-area-smoke.cjs, run in Chromium

findings.observed: Card shows 'ตอนที่ N' as a small kicker and again at the start of the title.
findings.rootCause: Episode titles in the JSON already begin with 'ตอนที่ N —' and the card adds its own kicker.

findings.observed: Two or three figures overlap torso and face; one figure looks semi-transparent where it crosses a building.
findings.evidenceFromJson: Starting x gaps in 9:16: 20 and 18 overlapped, 12-14 overlapped heavily, 25 and 27 touched but stayed readable. Previous threshold was 18 (strictly less than), so gaps of 18 and 20 passed.
findings.calibration: portrait review threshold raised 18 -> 24. One video, gaps judged by eye; treat as a review trigger, not a proven constant.

findings.observed: Reflector reads as a prohibition sign beside the characters; beacon is a flat yellow disc over the window rather than a lamp.
findings.note: The attached JSON contains no customAssets, so these shapes cannot be traced to authored data. Visual review only; no rule added.

findings.observed: A railing from the harbor set stays in the foreground of indoor scenes; path and tower scenes look like the workshop room; harbor has no visible boats.
findings.note: Layer carry-over cannot be confirmed from JSON alone. Visual review only; no rule added.

findings.observed: Quiet gaps are about 1.1 s between sentences. The two gaps near 3.6 s sit on the 2.5 s chapter cards, which the existing compiled-export evaluation treats as intentional.
findings.limits: silence detection only; narration content and voice quality were not assessed

training.note: Findings became deterministic preflight rules and regression tests. Nothing here is a human-approved ML label, and one video is not independent evidence for statistical training.
